iteration_note: V1 test was already observed; V2 is an audit repair iteration using a reused holdout, not a new blind test.
selection_rule: lowest mean projected validation MAE+1-MacroF1 across 5 preset conditions, then lowest numeric seed for representative model
output_rule: argmax polarity; Neutral->0; Negative->min(raw,-1e-6); Positive->max(raw,1e-6); checkpoint and variant selection use these same projected metrics.
